facts.text: Caroline painted a sunset after visiting the beach last week.

evidence.quote: I painted it after I visited the beach last week.

facts.text: Caroline's painting of a sunset was described as capturing the feeling of serenity and calm.

evidence.quote: I just had to try to capture that feeling in my painting.
You captured the sunset perfectly, so peaceful!

facts.text: Melanie expressed that Caroline's painting transported her to the moment of the sunset and evoked a sense of serenity.

evidence.quote: The art really took me to that moment and I can feel the serenity.
